summary: Viridian Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing the completion of a $250M public offering of 1.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, semiannual interest, convertible at holder's option under certain stock price conditions (130% of conversion price for 20 of 30 trading days). The filing details indenture mechanics and conversion triggers. This is a capital-raising event, returning cash to the company via debt issuance. Watch for dilution risk if conversion conditions are met; the 1.75% coupon and 2032 maturity provide low-cost financing for biotech development.
